hero.subtitle: From Ljubljana's streets to the emerald Soča Valley and the Adriatic coast, all in a single unforgettable day.

tour.title: The Tour
tour.description: Experience Slovenia's most breathtaking landscapes in one perfectly curated day. Your local guide takes you through hidden gorges, alongside the world's most beautiful river, and to the sparkling Adriatic, a journey that most visitors never manage to combine.

highlights.title: Why This Tour
highlights.h1desc: Your guide speaks Slovenian and English and knows every hidden gem along the route.
highlights.h2desc: Maximum 4 people means a personal, flexible experience, not a bus tour.
highlights.h3desc: Picked up and dropped off at your Ljubljana meeting point. No logistics stress.
highlights.h4desc: Mountains, river valleys and the Adriatic coast, Slovenia's full beauty in 10 hours.

steps.name: Pickup in Ljubljana
steps.desc: We meet in Ljubljana and start the day with a comfortable drive towards the mountains.

steps.name: Tolminska Korita
steps.desc: Explore one of Slovenia's most stunning natural attractions, a dramatic gorge with crystal-clear water and scenic viewpoints.

steps.name: Soča Valley Viewpoints
steps.desc: Stop at several viewpoints to see the famous emerald Soča River and take photos of this extraordinary landscape.

steps.name: Time to Relax
steps.desc: A short break to enjoy nature, take photos, or simply relax by the river at your own pace.

steps.name: Local Lunch Stop
steps.desc: Optional stop at a traditional Slovenian restaurant where guests can order food individually.

steps.name: Drive to the Coast
steps.desc: Scenic drive towards the Adriatic coast or the Italian border through beautiful Karst landscapes.

steps.name: Koper or Trieste
steps.desc: Walk through charming coastal streets, enjoy sea views, and have coffee or gelato by the water.

steps.name: Return to Ljubljana
steps.desc: Relax and enjoy the scenic ride back after a full, memorable day.

steps.name: Drop-off in Ljubljana
steps.desc: We return to the original meeting point. Your adventure is complete.

pricing.title: Simple Pricing
pricing.snackDesc: Choose tortillas, sandwiches, or yogurt bowls
pricing.note: The tour guide speaks Slovenian and English. Lunch is not included, there is an optional stop at a traditional restaurant.
